```

```
Use `--reset-between-passes` when proving flipped .NET state (Postgres is not reset by recreating
the mock).

Porting one endpoint can break another through shared state, shared repositories or a changed query,
so the **whole suite** must also be replayed:

```
node harness/replay.mjs --target http://localhost:8080     # the WHOLE suite
```

**That full-suite pass belongs to the module, once — not to each slice of it.** If this module was
split into sub-steps, the sub-steps replay their own routes and namespace; the run that resumes the
module after the last sub-step is the one that replays everything. Running the full suite once per
sub-step multiplies the most expensive check in the program by the number of slices and tells you
nothing the module-level pass will not.
